headline: RITES Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - RITES Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors of the Company in their meeting held today i.e. 25th June, 2026 has accorded its approval for formation and investment of capital in proposed Joint Venture…
detail: General Updates - RITES Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors of the Company in their meeting held today i.e. 25th June, 2026 has accorded its approval for formation and investment of capital in proposed Joint Venture Company between RITES Limited and NICC Infrastructure Construction LLC in the form of a Limited Liability Company (LLC) in United Arab Emirates (UAE).
